The petitioner apprehending her arrest in connection with Garhwa P.S. Case No.360 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 420/423/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa, has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa
entities.label: COURT

State of Bihar & Another reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273" , particularly paragraph no.12 of the same, followed by the judgement rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of "Satender Kumar Antil Vs.
